info.title: Outlook mail and calendar over Microsoft Graph
info.description: Twelve operations of Microsoft Graph v1.0 on the mail and the calendar of the person who connected, translated from Microsoft's OpenAPI description, which names no permission for any operation, with an oauth2 scheme at the endpoints of Microsoft's authorization server for work accounts. Each operation says only that it answers, since Microsoft's answers reach most of the schemas of Microsoft Graph.

left_out_descriptions.because: Microsoft's summary, description and link of each describe another operation: getting and creating an open extension, getting an event message and creating an extended property

scheme.name: microsoft_graph_oauth
scheme.lists_no_scopes: Microsoft's OpenAPI description names no permission for any operation, and its permissions reference names those of each, which the entry's way of consent asks
